{{Infobox character |image =Kuvalda FactoryBoss Screenshot.png |image size = |faction =[[Scavs]] |full name =Unknown |location =[[Factory]], [[Interchange]], [[Terminal]] |origin = |spawn chance = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Scav [[Boss]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Biography== People fear Tagilla far beyond the walls of Polikhim Plant #16. Some managed to flee the Factory after hearing his roar. But no one has ever survived his sledgehammer. Veterans still remember how Tagilla toyed with the PMC squads who dared to explore The Labyrinth beneath the health resort. ==Notes== * Tagilla has different health values than PMCs and Scavs. {|class="wikitable" !Tagilla's Health !Stats |- ![[File:Health_Tagilla.png|460px]] |Head: 100 Thorax: 320 Stomach: 260 Arms: 130 each Legs: 140 each '''Total: 1220''' |} * Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 triple slot pockets, bringing their total space to 15 slots. ==Quests== * Tagilla needs to be killed once each for the quests [[The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief]] and [[The Huntsman Path - Relentless]]. ==Location== Tagilla can be found on the following locations: ====[[Factory]]==== Has to be expected everywhere. ====[[Interchange]]==== In the parking garage below the Goshan store.
  • File:TagillaInterchangeMap.jpg|Location marked on map
    • ====[[Terminal]]==== In the medium container ship berths area. '''Note:''' Tagilla is only 1 of 5 possible bosses to spawn each raid.
  • File:Terminal Bosses Map.jpg|Location marked on map
    • ==Behavior== He is batshit insane and will attempt to hammer you down. However, if you are in a position that he cannot path-find to, such as the rafters, he will use his secondary weapon (usually a shotgun) to kill you from a distance. He's active immediately at the start of raid. The boss can set ambushes, open suppressive fire, and breach if needed. ==Strategy== If you are using high penetrating ammunition, aim for his head, not his thorax. If you have low pen or high flesh damage, aim for his stomach since his armor only covers the thorax. The best plan of action is to bait out his swing so he's standing still, then shoot him. If you shoot while he's running at you, he'll just charge through it and absolutely murder you, so wait until he swings to shoot. Tagillas welding masks do not protect his nape, therefore you can try to shoot him there. This strategy requires sneaking up behind him without you being detected, or a teammate that flanks him while he is fighting or chasing you. ==Equipment== Note that the primary weapons can have numerous mod variations and those shown below are examples.

    • ==Trivia== *Tagilla is the younger brother of [[Killa]], the boss on the [[Interchange]] location. *According to [[Jaeger]] in [[The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief]], Tagilla is a former employee of the Chemical Plant No. 16, which is the [[Factory]] location. *According to [[Jaeger]] in [[The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief]], Tagilla's custom welding masks are inspired by Killa's [[Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Killa Edition)|custom Maska-1SCh helmet]]. *Russia has the Tagil river and the city of Nizhny Tagil, which became famous thanks to the meme "Tagil rulit" in the Russian part of the internet. Briefly: The meme indicates indecent behavior while intoxicated. **Given this, and Tagilla's status as a worker at the Factory where [[TerraGroup]] was producing chemicals for drug research, it is possible that Tagilla's aggressive behavior and extreme physical toughness is caused by him being exposed to or otherwise under the influence of experimental drugs. * Tagilla is voiced by Russian actor [https://kupigolos.ru/diktory/zharkov-ivan Ivan Zharkov]. The same actor voices Thor in the Marvel films. {{Infobox character |image =KillaInfobox.png |image size = |faction =[[Scavs]] |full name =Unknown |location =[[Interchange]], [[Terminal]] |origin = |spawn chance = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Scav [[Boss]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Biography== Killa earned his reputation back in the days of the Contract Wars, when he and his crew took over the ULTRA shopping mall. For most locals, that mask with the three stripes means death. For a select few, it's a reminder of wild dubstep parties somewhere on the city's edge. ==Notes== *Killa has different health values than PMCs and Scavs. {|class="wikitable" !Killa's Health !Stats |- ![[File:KillaHealth.png|460px]] |Head: 70 Thorax: 210 Stomach: 170 Arms: 100 each Legs: 120 each '''Total: 890''' |} *Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 double slot pockets, bringing their total space to 10 slots. ==Quests== *Killa needs to be killed once each for the quests [[The Huntsman Path - Sellout]] and [[The Huntsman Path - Relentless]]. ==Location== Killa can be found on the following locations: ====[[Interchange]]==== * In the IDEA, OLI and Goshan stores in the ULTRA shopping mall * Around the center stores on the first and second floor of the ULTRA shopping mall

    • ==Behavior== Killa uses a light machine gun or other automatic weapon to suppress the enemy, while lurking from cover to cover, getting closer to his target for the final push. During the assault he moves in a zig-zag pattern, uses smoke and fragmentation grenades, and relentlessly suppresses enemies with automatic fire. He will follow his target large distances out of his patrol route, so be sure to run very far to get away from him if he has locked onto you. ==Strategy== It is recommended to avoid being spotted by Killa. He has multiple grenades and is generally accurate with his bursts. If you are close to him he will continuously push the player and relentlessly hunt them until he ambushes and assaults them. It is best to attack him with high-penetration ammunition such as [[5.45x39mm BS gs|5.45 BS]], [[5.56x45mm M995|5.56 M995]], or [[7.62x51mm NATO|7.62x51]]. Without proper ammunition to kill him, shredding his [[6B13 M assault armor (Killa Edition)|6B13 M]] to low durability or firing solely at his legs are both appropriate, albeit more risky, strategies. Grenades generally won't work to kill him, as he is a highly mobile fighter and will rarely be pinned down long enough for a grenade to stop him. If fighting him with a teammate, attacking him from two different directions and peeking cover is a sound strategy, as he will continue to suppress one of his opponents while the other can safely return fire. It is extremely important to utilize cover and stay mobile when fighting him, and to always be mindful of one's ammo count—if he's armed with his [[RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun|RPK-16]], he will likely outgun the player with his [[RPK-16 5.45x39 95-round drum magazine|95-round drum mag]] and supplementary [[AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine]]. ==Equipment== Note that the primary weapons can have numerous mod variations and those shown below are examples.

[[File:TherapistInsuranceScreen.png|thumb|right|300px|The insurance selection screen]] '''{{PAGENAME}}''' allows you to retrieve any items that have not been extracted from a raid, with a delay.
You can only insure gear items (like [[weapon]]s and [[Armor vests|armors]]). Items such as containers (a [[Key tool]], a [[Documents case]] or an [[Item case]]) and intel items ([[Keys & Intel|paper maps]]) and consumable items ([[Food]], [[Medical|Meds]] or [[Ammo]]) cannot be insured. However, there are [[Insurance#Exceptions|exceptions]] to the insurance system which should not be ignored.
[[Secure containers]], the [[EYE MK.2 professional hand-held compass|Compass]], [[Weapons#Melee weapons|Melee weapons]] (Except the [[Cultist knife]]), and [[Armbands]] cannot be insured nor be looted from your body upon death as long as they are equipped in their appropriate slot, and do not need to be insured.
Insured items have a thick yellow outline around the stash space they occupy.
==Insurers== {{Seasonal change|the insurance service is not offered by any trader.}} [[File:InsureAll.png|thumb|right|300px|"Insure All" and "Insure" buttons]] Except for raids in [[The Lab]], [[The Labyrinth]] and on [[Icebreaker]], make sure to always insure the gear you go out with using the insurance screen, just before entering the lobby. You can click on the "Insure All" button to make sure that you select all of your belongings. To confirm, press the "Insure" button just above "Ready". You can choose to insure with [[Prapor]], [[Therapist]], or [[Jaeger]]: * [[Prapor]] returns insured items after 12–20 hours. You have 7 days (168h) to collect the returned items. * [[Therapist]] returns insured items after 6–10 hours. You have 10 days (240h) to collect the returned items. * [[Jaeger]] returns insured items after 1–2 hours. You have 1 day (24h) to collect the returned items.
Higher loyalty levels with the respective traders offer a discount on the fee.
[[File:StashInsure.png|thumb|right|185px|The insurance screen while used in a player's stash]] It is also possible to insure items directly in your stash by simply right clicking on the item, and then selecting "Insure". You can then select which insurer to use. It should be noted that if you insure a container, everything inside that container will also be insured as well. This can be used as a quick method of insuring multiple weapons, mods, or other items all at once. Any items insured using this method will show up in the pre-raid insurance screen.
===Insurance modifiers=== * Upgrading the [[Hideout]] module "Intelligence Center" to level 2 reduces the item return time by 20% (30% with elite [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]]) * Buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game have a 30% reduced item return time * Owning the "The Unheard" edition of the game doubles the allowed time to collect the returned items
==Strategy== Use the insurance system, even at a low level: There's always the chance that your killer won't loot you, or leave it behind as they find better gear. If an AI ([[Scav|Scavs]], [[Scav Raiders]] or [[Bosses]]) kills you, there's a high chance you'll get everything back.
Your insurer will contact you a few hours/days later to let you know what came back. You can then claim the items from the messenger tab. If you do not claim them in the available collect time, the insured items will be lost.
A side-effect of insurance is the ability to differentiate your items from looted items. This can be useful when looting a body with the same magazines as yours, but different ammunition that you may not wish to use.
Discarding insured items into an obscure or hidden location can help prevent them from being taken. This makes it more difficult for other players to loot since they will be a lot harder to find if they're not on your corpse. It's good to do this when guns or magazines you have insured are out of ammo.
==Exceptions== ===MIA=== Ending a raid with the Missing in Action status will not bring back insured equipped items. The Missing in Action status can be achieved if:
* You do not extract before the end of the raid * You die from dehydration
If you do not think you are going to make it to the extraction point in time, you should throw away your insured items.
===Non-insured items inside insured containers=== * If you insure a [[Weapon mods#Magazines|magazine]] with ammunition inside, you will only get the magazine back. In the same fashion, an insured [[Backpacks|backpack]] or [[Chest rigs|chest rig]] with [[Medical|medical items]] inside will not yield the [[Medical|meds]] back. * If an insured container is lost, and contains an uninsured item (for example, a [[Backpacks|backpack]] containing a weapon you looted), the uninsured item will not be brought back with the container.
===Locations=== * Insurers will not bring back items lost in [[The Lab]], [[The Labyrinth]] and on [[Icebreaker]].

==Additional Modules Information== ===Gym=== To be able to start a training session you need to have at least 60 Energy and 60 Hydration. In a training session you can do up to 15 quick time events (QTE) where each successful one can randomly grant [[Strength]] or [[Endurance]] skill points based on your current skill level. For every successful QTE you lose 2 Energy and 2 Hydration, while failing a QTE you lose 4 Energy and 4 Hydration. * Between level 0-9 you get 2.4 [[Strength]] or [[Endurance]] skill points / successful QTE. * Between level 10-24 you get 2.0 [[Strength]] or [[Endurance]] skill points / successful QTE. * Between level 25-50 you get 1.6 [[Strength]] or [[Endurance]] skill points / successful QTE. In order to do a QTE, you need to left-click the mouse when the shrinking hexagon hits the border of the inner hexagon, so that the border turns green. Failing to do so will result in a red border. The size of inner hexagon varies each attempt. After the first training session you get the [[File:Mildmusclepain.png|46px|Mild Muscle Pain]] effect for 24h where you can gain only 50% [[Strength]] and [[Endurance]] skill points in the next training session. After the second training session you get the [[File:Severemusclepain.png|46px|Severe Muscle Pain]] effect where you gain 0 skill points for both skills. When failing a QTE, there is a 10% chance to get a [[File:Fracture.png|46px|Fracture]] and stop the session. ===Hall of Fame=== The Hall of Fame gives skill leveling bonuses based on the amount and levels of stored opposing faction dogtags. The dogtag bonus is equal to the sum of levels divided by 5 and multiplied by the 0.1% bonus, where the decimal number is rounded up in favor of the player starting from level 3 (levels 3-7 = 0.1% bonus, levels 8-12 = 0.2% bonus). ===Bitcoin Farm=== The Bitcoin Farm produces [[Physical Bitcoin]]s at a rate of 1/(300000/(1+(GC-1)*0.041225)/3600) items/hour, where GC is the number of installed [[Graphics card]]s. Production stops if there are no installed graphics cards, the power is off, or there are 3 Bitcoins awaiting collection. (5 with Elite [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]]). The hour/Bitcoin rate of any given graphics card amount can be calculated with 300000/(1+(GC-1)*0.041225)/3600. ===Cultist Circle=== * You can sacrifice up to 5 items to the Cultist circle. * The base values (in ₽) of the sacrificed items are added up. * The total value determines the possible value of items received as gift from the Cultists. ** When the value of a sacrifice is ₽350,001 or more, there is an increased chance to receive rare and high value items. If the threshold is reached, the sacrifice will take 14 hours. ** When the value of a sacrifice is ₽400,000 or more, there is a 25% chance to receive items needed for active quests and unfinished Hideout modules. If the chance is triggered, the sacrifice will take 6 hours. If not, it will be 14 hours. ** The value of sacrificed items can be increased by 15% through placing a [[Sacred Amulet]] in the amulet slot (Each sacrifice consumes 1 use). *** The [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]] further increases the amulet bonus. =====Unique Sacrifices===== Some items trigger a special ritual with a unique outcome when they are sacrificed. It is the sixth map that was added to the game. ==Description== Secret underground TerraGroup Labs facility hidden right under the center of Tarkov. Officially, this research center does not exist and, based on data scraps, is engaged in research and development as well as testing and simulation of projects in chemistry, physics, biology, and other high technology. ==Notes== * {{PAGENAME}} is initially only accessible by [[Transits|transiting]]. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. * This location can only be entered with a [[TerraGroup Labs access keycard]]. ==Features== ===Insurance=== All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance [[Traders]] will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process. [[File:TheLab-Insurance-Messages-01.PNG]] ===Illumination=== The illumination can be disabled by turning off the power in the basement.

The M1911A1 is the second generation of the original M1911 pistol.
